name: 35442-sharegpt-80b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, four cards of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), sm90. Driver 570.195.03, torch 2.10.0+cu128.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM hybrid decoder, 48 layers of which 12 are full-attention and 36 linear-attention; 512 experts with 10 active plus one shared; FP8 e4m3 weights, ~80 GB total and ~20 GB per GPU at TP4. The multi-token-prediction head ships in the same repo, so there is no separate draft checkpoint.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate = 1.0 request per second, bounded at 200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. No warmup and no cooldown: all 200 requests are in the measured window.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, one request per row of `configs/data/sharegpt-200-qwen3next.jsonl`: 200 first-turn ShareGPT prompts, each with the length of that conversation's real reply as its output length. Single turn, no tools; mean 217.8 prompt and 223.5 output tokens, max 975 in / 781 out, 43560 prompt and 44697 output tokens in total. Every row carries an explicit output length, so `ignore_eos` applies and generation runs to exactly that many tokens. `request_format` is `plain` against `/v1/completions`, so no chat template is applied. Sampling is the checkpoint's own `generation_config.json` (temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20) plus `repetition_penalty: 1.0`, written into `scenario.json`; it is not greedy. `configs/data/make-dataset.py` regenerates the file and asserts those totals.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on an 80-billion-parameter model across four GPUs, serving one short conversational request per second.
launch:
# The engine runs IN-PROCESS through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend, so there is no HTTP server
# and no --port. Nothing here is tuned and no knob is declared tunable.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
max-model-len: 262144

# KEEP ON ONE LINE: the engine reads this file line by line and skips indented ones, so
# re-flowing the mapping drops the key and the engine starts without it at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "qwen3_next_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}

dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Written out because the in-process entry point resolves these two to 2048 / 128, not to the
# 8192 / 1024 an API server on this class of card would get.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
